elements_selected.content: Write integration tests verifying P0 and P1 fixes work end-to-end. Create tests/test_integration_p0_p1.py with 5 scenarios using mock embeddings (no real API calls): (1) Session state persistence across callers: simulate MCP search (call search_chunks_contextual with mode), then load shared state and verify surfaced files recorded, then simulate hook-style search verifying resurfacing penalty applies. (2) Bidirectional state: record surfaced via hook-style call, verify MCP-style call sees them. (3) Circling detection across callers: record query in shared state, verify circling files detected on similar query from other caller. (4) Stratified pool effectiveness: insert fixture chunks heavily skewed toward documentation type (20 doc, 3 research, 3 code), run think-with mode search, verify research chunks appear in results despite low baseline rank. (5) Cooldown shared: set last_query_time in shared state, verify hook gate rejects within cooldown window. Tests must be self-contained: create their own fixture DB and clean up /tmp/sense-session-state.json.
